sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A rhizomatous perennial native to China and Mongolia, growing in open, dry habitats such as grassy slopes. Its linear basal leaves are about 10–60 cm long. The flowering scape reaches roughly 35–100 cm and bears a raceme of small pale flowers.

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: The rhizome is documented as a traditional Chinese medicinal material. The sources consulted do not establish food use.
